name: SPIKE Rooms Protected Migration Baseline
purpose: Immutable reference registry for rebuilding SPIKE Rooms after retirement of the previous Room frontend implementation.
rules: Never delete, rename, or overwrite any protected migration.
Reuse existing capabilities through compatible integrations.
Put all Room-specific schema, RPC, policy, trigger, and notification changes in new additive migrations.
Do not weaken Direct Message authorization, unified notifications, admin controls, intelligence, or policy enforcement.
Do not deploy migrations automatically as part of this source-package update.

protected_files.role: Typing broadcast foundation; preserve the original migration and build room-specific behavior in additive migrations.
Direct-message typing authorization hardening; retain its DM security contract.
Admin control-center infrastructure; integrate room administration through compatible additions.
Leveling-field cleanup history; do not reintroduce removed residual fields or rewrite this migration.
SPIKE intelligence infrastructure; reuse through compatible room integrations.
Unified notification event pipeline; room events must use compatible additions, not a competing notification system.
Policy enforcement, appeals, and recommendations; preserve security and governance contracts.
